name: @media
description: Applies a block of CSS rules only when the specified condition, such as a viewport width, matches.
parameters: Common conditions: min-width, max-width, orientation, prefers-color-scheme.

name: viewport meta tag
description: An HTML tag placed in the document head that tells mobile browsers to render the page at the device's actual width instead of a scaled-down desktop layout.
notes: Without it, media queries based on device width won't behave as expected on mobile browsers.

name: rem unit
description: A relative length unit based on the root (html) element's font-size, unaffected by the font-size of any parent element.
notes: Preferred over em for most sizing since it avoids compounding when nested inside elements with different font sizes.

name: em unit
description: A relative length unit based on the font-size of the element it's used on (or the parent's font-size, for font-size itself).
notes: Useful for sizing that should scale with an element's own text, like button padding.

name: Percentage (%) unit
description: A relative length unit calculated as a percentage of a parent element's corresponding dimension.
notes: Percentage height requires the parent to have an explicit height, or it typically resolves to auto.

name: vw / vh units
description: Relative length units equal to 1% of the viewport's width (vw) or height (vh).
notes: On mobile browsers, 100vh can include space behind the address bar — consider dvh units for more accurate mobile heights.

name: Mobile-first approach
description: A responsive design strategy where base styles target small screens by default, and min-width media queries progressively add styles for larger viewports.
notes: Tends to produce simpler, more performant CSS than a desktop-first approach using max-width overrides.

name: clamp()
description: Returns a value that scales with the preferred value but is clamped between a minimum and maximum, useful for fluid typography and spacing.
parameters: min — lower bound. preferred — ideal, often viewport-relative value. max — upper bound.

name: min() / max()
description: Picks the smallest (min()) or largest (max()) value from a comma-separated list of values, which can mix units.

name: @container
description: Applies styles to an element based on the size of its nearest ancestor marked as a container, instead of the viewport.
notes: Requires setting container-type (or the container shorthand) on an ancestor before @container rules can target it.
